project: Des Moines AI Pulse - Android Audit
description: Deep audit of the native Android app covering UI/UX, performance, and security. Addresses critical security hardening (backup rules, network timeouts), Compose performance optimizations (@Immutable annotations), and UX improvements (swipe-to-dismiss favorites, BackHandler for sheets, scroll-to-top on tab switch, string resources for i18n). All items discovered via comprehensive code review of the Kotlin/Jetpack Compose codebase.

userStories.title: Disable automatic backup and add data extraction rules
userStories.description: As a user, I need my sensitive data (auth tokens, encrypted preferences, biometric settings) excluded from Android auto-backup so that my account cannot be compromised if my cloud backup is accessed by another device.
acceptanceCriteria: Set android:allowBackup="false" in AndroidManifest.xml
Add android:dataExtractionRules="@xml/data_extraction_rules" for Android 12+ (API 31+)
Add android:fullBackupContent="@xml/backup_rules" for Android 11 and below
Create res/xml/data_extraction_rules.xml that excludes: shared_prefs (contains encrypted tokens), databases (Room cache), no_backup directory
Create res/xml/backup_rules.xml with matching exclusion rules for pre-API-31
Allow backup of non-sensitive preferences (theme, onboarding state) if desired
Verify manifest compiles without errors
userStories.notes: FIXED: Set android:allowBackup=false in AndroidManifest.xml. Created res/xml/data_extraction_rules.xml for Android 12+ and res/xml/backup_rules.xml for pre-API-31. Both exclude sharedpref, database, no_backup, and cache domains from cloud backup and device transfer.

userStories.title: Add network request timeouts to OkHttp/Supabase client
userStories.description: As a user, I need network requests to have reasonable timeouts so the app doesn't hang indefinitely when the server is unresponsive, preventing ANRs and poor UX.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure connect timeout of 30 seconds on the OkHttp client in CertificatePinningService.createPinnedClient()
Configure read timeout of 30 seconds
Configure write timeout of 30 seconds
Configure call timeout of 60 seconds as an overall safety net
Apply the same timeouts to the image loading OkHttp client in DesMoinesInsiderApp.kt
Verify existing certificate pinning still works with the timeout configuration
userStories.notes: FIXED: Added 30s connect/read/write timeouts and 60s call timeout to CertificatePinningService.createPinnedClient(). Added 30s connect/read timeouts to image loading OkHttpClient in DesMoinesInsiderApp. Timeouts are applied before certificate pinning configuration so both work together.

userStories.title: Add @Immutable annotations to data model classes for Compose stability
userStories.description: As a developer, I need data model classes annotated with @Immutable so the Compose compiler can skip unnecessary recompositions, improving scroll performance and reducing frame drops.
acceptanceCriteria: Add @Immutable annotation to Event data class in data/model/Event.kt
Add @Immutable annotation to Restaurant data class in data/model/Restaurant.kt
Add @Immutable annotation to Attraction data class in data/model/Attraction.kt
Add @Immutable annotation to LatLng data class in data/model/LatLng.kt
Add @Immutable annotation to EventCategory enum if present
Verify all annotated classes are truly immutable (all val properties, no mutable collections)
Ensure kotlinx.serialization @Serializable still works with @Immutable
userStories.notes: FIXED: Added @Immutable from androidx.compose.runtime to Event, Restaurant, Attraction, and LatLng data classes. All classes verified to have only val properties and immutable List<String> collections. EventCategory is an enum (already stable by default in Compose). @Serializable and @Immutable coexist without conflict as they target different compilation phases.

userStories.title: Add swipe-to-dismiss gesture on favorites list items
userStories.description: As a user, I want to swipe left on saved items in my Favorites screen to quickly remove them, matching modern Android UX patterns and reducing friction for managing saved content.
acceptanceCriteria: Add SwipeToDismissBox (Material 3) wrapper around FavoriteEventRow items
Add SwipeToDismissBox wrapper around FavoriteRestaurantRow items
Show red background with delete icon when swiping end-to-start
Trigger haptic feedback on dismiss threshold
Call existing onRemoveEventFavorite/onRemoveRestaurantFavorite on dismiss
Add animateItem() modifier to LazyColumn items for smooth removal animation
Ensure accessibility: swipe action has proper semantics label
Keep the existing heart icon button as an alternative removal method
userStories.notes: FIXED: Added SwipeToDismissBox (Material 3) wrapper around all favorite list items in FavoritesScreen.kt. Created SwipeToDismissItem composable with: end-to-start swipe with animated red errorContainer background, delete icon, haptic feedback on dismiss threshold, proper accessibility semantics. Wraps FavoriteEventRow (upcoming + past) and FavoriteRestaurantRow items. Existing heart icon button preserved as alternative removal method.

acceptanceCriteria: Add BackHandler in MainScreen.kt that dismisses ModalBottomSheet if visible before allowing back navigation
Add BackHandler in HomeScreen.kt FilterSheet composable
Ensure back press closes search overlay before navigating away from SearchScreen
Test that normal back navigation still works when no sheets are open
